back: Time from injection to detection of a component in GLC.
Mobile: unreactive carrier gas (N₂, He, Ar). Stationary: high-boiling liquid on a solid support in a heated column.
Higher boiling point, stronger attraction to the stationary phase, longer column; lower temperature or slower gas flow.
% of component = peak area ÷ total area of all peaks × 100 (equal detector response assumed).
GC separates; MS identifies each component from its mass spectrum; used in drug testing and contaminant analysis.
Liquid mobile phase pumped at high pressure through fine particles; for non-volatile or heat-sensitive substances.
Components elute roughly in order of increasing boiling point.
